paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon bar Karsana: Jerusalem Talmud Demai, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1; some read Barsana.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:1 has Rabbi Shimon bar Karsani (כרסני). Hyman gives Karsana (כרסנא) and reports Barsana (ברסנא).

The actual Guggenheimer digital paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:1 has Rabbi Shimon bar Karsani (כרסני), supporting the local full title. Hyman’s Karsana (כרסנא) and reported Barsana (ברסנא) remain distinct supplied forms. No spelling repair, variant identity binding, or additional legal teaching is adopted.
